statement: The completed run covers the five image-quality/identity scripts in the local ViCo baseline. It is not the complete original-paper or later-paper motion/synchrony evaluation suite. Existing RESULTS.json, COMPLETE.json and FINAL_AUDIT.json remain unchanged.
matching_table_notes: CustomListener Table1 reports motion-space metrics; Table2 separately reports image-quality metrics.
FD in that table is L1 feature distance, not Frechet Distance.
FD and FID_delta_fm values in that table are multiplied by 100.
Exact comparison requires matching 3DMM extractor/basis, normalization, FPS, lag windows, sequence handling and aggregation.
